manifest.name: teammate-agent
manifest.description: One teammate agent of one space (backlog:8986f4459f0f): a named agent with a role and working instructions plus an optional monthly spending cap in cents. Every row is managed: an agent exists only through the agents package create operation. (backlog:8986f4459f0f)

migrations.name: create_teammate_agents
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS teammate_agents (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  space_id TEXT,
  name TEXT,
  role TEXT,
  instructions TEXT,
  spending_cap_cents INTEGER,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('active', 'paused')),
  decided_at TEXT,
  actor_type TEXT CHECK(actor_type IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  actor_id TEXT,
  source_package TEXT,
  source_action TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS teammate_agents_space_id ON teammate_agents(space_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS teammate_agents_source_package ON teammate_agents(source_package);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_teammate_agents
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."teammate_agents" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "space_id" TEXT,
  "name" TEXT,
  "role" TEXT,
  "instructions" TEXT,
  "spending_cap_cents" BIGINT,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('active', 'paused')),
  "decided_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "actor_type" TEXT CHECK("actor_type" IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  "actor_id" TEXT,
  "source_package" TEXT,
  "source_action" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "teammate_agents_space_id"
  ON "accordo"."teammate_agents"("space_id");

CREATE INDEX "teammate_agents_source_package"
  ON "accordo"."teammate_agents"("source_package");
